name: Thermally toughened
process: Heated like heat-strengthened glass and quenched hard by air (EN 12150). The faces go into high compression over a core in tension: about two and a half times annealed float's characteristic strength (120 against 45 MPa), and four times its mean breaking stress (165 against 41 MPa). It breaks into small blunt dice and cannot be cut afterwards. A rare nickel-sulphide inclusion can make it break by itself years later; a heat soak test (EN 14179) screens most of them out.

strainPattern.description: As heat-strengthened: quench marks visible in polarised skylight, most at oblique angles or through polarising sunglasses. They are inherent to all heat-treated glass and are not a defect.
